But every time she thought she was over them the emotions returned. They had dreamed of performing together. And now she was sharing the song she wrote for them alone.*

I'll get better. Just bare with me through it. It'll get better after."
*she looked over to the group, including her temporary guitarist since her permanent one quit and asked while she tried to get ahold of her self.* "Can we start again?"
